title: Programme Office Ruling on Spend Already Met from a Registration's Credit
content:
Ruling of the programme office on the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes: where credit has already been spent from a registration under a programme that allows the credit to be spent in parts, part or all of that spend is treated as already met when the least the customer must spend is fixed.

## The ruling

Where the spends booked to the registration come to at least a quarter (25 percent) of the credit it shows as issued and the programme allows the credit to be spent in parts, the whole of what has been spent is treated as already met. Where those spends come to less than a quarter of the credit shown as issued and the programme allows the credit to be spent in parts, half (0.5) of what has been spent, rounded to two decimal places, is treated as already met. Under a programme that does not allow the credit to be spent in parts, or where nothing has been spent, no part is treated as already met.

The spends booked are the spend entries on the registration, taken at their absolute amount and summed. The quarter is 25 percent of the credit the registration shows as issued, rounded to two decimal places.

| Programme | Credit may be spent in parts |
|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | no |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | no |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | yes |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | yes |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | yes |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | yes |

## Boundary examples on a credit shown as issued of 8000 USD

A quarter of 8000 USD is 2000.00 USD.

- Spends of 2000 USD under the Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee: they reach the quarter, and 2000.00 USD is treated as already met.
- Spends of 1999 USD under the same programme: below the quarter, so half of 1999, which is 999.50 USD, is treated as already met.
- Spends of 3000 USD under the Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee: the programme does not allow part-spending, and nothing is treated as already met.
